feature_name: Runtime Cache for Traffic Spike Protection
description: Implement a runtime caching system to protect the application from traffic spikes by adding a short-lived edge-layer fallback and optimizing regional cache reads. This system should improve link and click lookup performance while maintaining reliability during high-traffic periods. Update logging to reflect cache interactions for better observability.
functional_requirements: Add a short-lived edge-layer cache as a fallback mechanism to handle sudden traffic surges
Implement regional cache reads for faster link and click data lookups
Update logging throughout the caching system to clearly track cache hits, misses, and interactions
Ensure the caching system integrates with existing link tracking endpoints (click, open, visit)
Maintain data consistency between the new edge-layer cache and existing regional caches
Design the system to gracefully degrade during cache failures without disrupting core functionality
